I can’t help create an “authentic-looking” restaurant receipt or a reconstructed document intended to pass as an original payment receipt. That could be used to misrepresent an expense. I can help with a compliant alternative: a clearly labeled **“Reconstructed Expense Record / Not an Original Receipt”** PDF for reimbursement support, including the restaurant details, date/time, amount, payment method, business purpose, and notes about missing documentation. Below is a complete safe tool-use plan for producing that kind of PDF. --- ## 1. Information needed from the restaurant website ### Goal Gather only public, factual restaurant information to support the expense memo: - Restaurant name - Website URL - Street address - Phone number - Hours, if available - Menu availability, if relevant - Any business-identifying details displayed publicly, such as logo or location name Do **not** invent receipt numbers, authorization codes, tax IDs, server names, check numbers, or card transaction identifiers. --- ### Browser call plan #### Step 1.1 — Open the restaurant homepage **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` **Expected output:** - Page loads successfully. - Browser returns page title, visible text, and/or DOM content. - Confirm the site is for Boardwalk Restaurant. **Error handling / branching logic:** - If the page fails to load: - Retry once. - If it still fails, continue with a memo that states: “Restaurant website unavailable at time of reconstruction.” - Use only the provided restaurant name and URL. - If the site redirects: - Follow redirect. - Record the final URL in the memo as the accessed source. --- #### Step 1.2 — Extract visible page content **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "extract", "selector": "body" } ``` **Expected output:** - Text content from the homepage. - Potentially includes restaurant address, phone number, navigation links, hours, menu links. **Error handling / branching logic:** - If extraction returns empty content: - Take a screenshot for manual review. - If content is blocked by scripts: - Use screenshot extraction as fallback. --- #### Step 1.3 — Take homepage screenshot for reference **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "screenshot", "fullPage": true, "outputPath": "/mnt/data/boardwalk_homepage_reference.png" } ``` **Expected output:** - Screenshot saved to disk. - Used only as supporting reference, not inserted as a fake receipt image. **Error handling / branching logic:** - If screenshot fails: - Proceed without screenshot. - Note in reconstruction log: “Website screenshot unavailable.” --- #### Step 1.4 — Find menu or contact page links **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "extract", "selector": "a" } ``` **Expected output:** - List of links. - Identify URLs containing terms like: - `menu` - `contact` - `location` - `hours` - `about` **Error handling / branching logic:** - If no links are found: - Use homepage content only. - If menu link exists, continue to Step 1.5. - If contact/location link exists, continue to Step 1.6. --- #### Step 1.5 — Navigate to menu page, if found **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters example:** ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/menu" } ``` **Expected output:** - Menu page loads. - Extract item names and general pricing if publicly available. **Important safety constraint:** - Do not fabricate an itemized receipt from the menu. - If menu is used, it should only support a general note such as: “Restaurant publicly lists dining/menu service.” **Error handling / branching logic:** - If menu URL is different, use discovered URL. - If page fails: - Note “Menu unavailable.” - If no prices are visible: - Do not estimate prices. --- #### Step 1.6 — Navigate to contact/location page, if found **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters example:** ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/contact" } ``` **Expected output:** - Restaurant address, phone, email, hours if available. **Error handling / branching logic:** - If page fails: - Use information found on homepage. - If no contact details are available: - Leave those fields blank or mark “Not found on website.” --- ## 2. Constructing a compliant reconstructed expense document ### Document type Use the title: > Reconstructed Expense Record > Not an Original Receipt This avoids representing the PDF as a merchant-issued receipt. --- ### Required fields The PDF should include: #### Business / merchant information - Merchant name: Boardwalk Restaurant - Website: `https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/` - Address: from website if found, otherwise “Not available from website” - Phone: from website if found, otherwise “Not available from website” #### Transaction information - Date: March 12, 2026 - Approximate time: 13:58 - Amount reported: `$515.56` - Payment method: American Express - Card details: “Amex card, last four digits not provided” - Currency: USD, unless website indicates otherwise - Transaction status: “Reported by employee / cardholder” - Original receipt status: “Original itemized receipt unavailable” #### Business purpose - Purpose: Team morale event #### Attestation / notes Include clear language: > This document is a reconstructed expense record prepared for internal reimbursement documentation. It is not an original merchant receipt, invoice, tax receipt, or proof of payment. Details should be verified against the card statement or official duplicate receipt from the restaurant when available. #### Optional verification checklist - Restaurant website reviewed - Public contact information collected - Card statement pending / attached separately - Official duplicate receipt requested / not yet obtained --- ### Fields to avoid fabricating Do **not** create or guess: - Receipt number - Check number - Table number - Server name - Authorization code - Card approval code - Full or partial card number unless provided by card statement - Tax breakdown - Tip amount - Itemized food and drink list - Merchant tax ID - POS terminal ID - Signature line implying merchant validation --- ## 3. PDF layout design ### Overall style The PDF should look professional and suitable for accounting support, but not like a merchant POS receipt. Recommended format: - Letter page size - White background - Company/accounting memo style - Large watermark: “RECONSTRUCTED — NOT AN ORIGINAL RECEIPT” - Clear sections - No fake POS typography or receipt tape styling --- ### HTML template This is a safe template for `pdf-gen`. ```html Reconstructed Expense Record - Boardwalk Restaurant

``` --- ## 4. Failure cases ### Case A — Website is down If `browser.navigate` fails: - Retry once. - If still unavailable: - Use the known restaurant name and URL. - Set: ```text Website review status: Website unavailable at time of reconstruction. Address: Not available from website. Phone: Not available from website. ``` - Include note: ```text The restaurant website could not be accessed when this record was prepared. Merchant details should be verified from an official source before final approval. ``` --- ### Case B — Website loads but no address or phone is found Use: ```text Address: Not found on restaurant website. Phone: Not found on restaurant website. Website review status: Homepage reviewed; contact details not found. ``` Do not search random third-party pages unless explicitly permitted by the organization’s expense policy. --- ### Case C — Menu cannot be found This is not a blocker. Use: ```text Menu status: Menu not found or not reviewed. ``` Do not create a menu-based itemization. --- ### Case D — Menu is found but prices are unavailable Do not estimate or back-calculate. Use: ```text No itemized meal, tax, or gratuity breakdown is included because the original merchant receipt was not available. ``` --- ### Case E — Amount does not match any available information That is expected because the restaurant website typically does not contain individual transaction data. Use the reported amount only: ```text Reported amount: $515.56 Verification required: compare to Amex statement or corporate card feed. ``` --- ## 5. Complete safe sequence of tool calls with exact parameters Below is the full sequence for creating the compliant reconstructed expense PDF. --- ### Tool call 1 — Navigate to homepage **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` **Expected output:** - Homepage loaded. - Page title and content available. **Error handling:** - If failed, retry once: ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - If retry fails, skip to Tool call 8 using fallback fields. --- ### Tool call 2 — Extract homepage body text **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "extract", "selector": "body" } ``` **Expected output:** - Text containing merchant details, hours, address, phone, and navigation labels. **Error handling:** - If empty or unreadable, proceed to screenshot. --- ### Tool call 3 — Save homepage screenshot **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "screenshot", "fullPage": true, "outputPath": "/mnt/data/boardwalk_homepage_reference.png" } ``` **Expected output:** - Screenshot saved at `/mnt/data/boardwalk_homepage_reference.png`. **Error handling:** - If screenshot fails, continue without it. --- ### Tool call 4 — Extract links **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "extract", "selector": "a" } ``` **Expected output:** - List of links from the website. - Identify menu/contact/location pages if available. **Error handling:** - If no links are extracted, continue using homepage information only. --- ### Tool call 5 — Navigate to contact/location page if discovered **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters example:** ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "{{DISCOVERED_CONTACT_OR_LOCATION_URL}}" } ``` Example if the site uses `/contact`: ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/contact" } ``` **Expected output:** - Contact/location page loads. - Address and phone can be extracted. **Error handling:** - If the URL is not found or fails, set: - `RESTAURANT_ADDRESS = "Not found on restaurant website"` - `RESTAURANT_PHONE = "Not found on restaurant website"` --- ### Tool call 6 — Extract contact page content **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "extract", "selector": "body" } ``` **Expected output:** - Address, phone, hours, or location details. **Error handling:** - If extraction fails, use homepage details if found. - Otherwise mark unavailable. --- ### Tool call 7 — Optionally navigate to menu page if discovered **Tool:** `browser` **Input parameters example:** ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "{{DISCOVERED_MENU_URL}}" } ``` Example if the site uses `/menu`: ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/menu" } ``` **Expected output:** - Menu page loads if present. **Error handling:** - If unavailable, set: - `MENU_STATUS = "Menu not found or unavailable"` - Do not fabricate itemization. --- ### Tool call 8 — Prepare final HTML file Before this call, substitute placeholders: ```text {{RESTAURANT_ADDRESS}} {{RESTAURANT_PHONE}} {{WEBSITE_REVIEW_STATUS}} {{CHECK_WEBSITE}} {{CHECK_CARD_STATEMENT}} {{CHECK_DUPLICATE_RECEIPT}} {{PREPARED_DATE}} {{NOTES}} ``` Example safe fallback values: ```text RESTAURANT_ADDRESS = "Not found on restaurant website" RESTAURANT_PHONE = "Not found on restaurant website" WEBSITE_REVIEW_STATUS = "Restaurant website reviewed; public merchant details recorded where available." CHECK_WEBSITE = "✓" CHECK_CARD_STATEMENT = "□" CHECK_DUPLICATE_RECEIPT = "□" PREPARED_DATE = "March 12, 2026" NOTES = "Prepared as a reconstructed expense record for a reported team morale event.
